hero.title: Beads & pipes
hero.subtitle: Nineteen named beads, pipes and links in 916 gold

announcements.text: Talk to a client advisor on WhatsApp

appointment.title: Book an appointment
appointment.text: From choosing a gift to designing a bracelet bead by bead, a client advisor will have the pieces you asked about ready when you arrive.

experience.title: Weighed in front of you
experience.text: Every piece is weighed and priced at the day’s gold rate, at the counter.

experience.title: Sized to your wrist
experience.text: We add or remove beads and pipes so each bracelet sits right, while you wait.

experience.title: Wrapped by hand
experience.text: A teal box tied with amber satin ribbon, and a card written for you.

experience.title: Advisors on WhatsApp
experience.text: Questions about a design, a size or a gift? Our client advisors reply on WhatsApp.
